'''Danurorus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing in [[Mos Ila]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he managed a small vendor stand, selling various modification upgrades.
